title: OpenAI launches always-on Dots agents for work across apps
friendlyTitle: OpenAI’s new agents can keep working across your apps
summary: OpenAI unveiled Dots, persistent agents powered by GPT-6 Astra that can pursue goals across Slack, Teams and other workplace tools. OpenAI says sensitive actions require explicit consent, although live demonstrations also exposed reliability glitches.
friendlySummary: OpenAI introduced Dots, AI helpers that can continue working on a goal in tools such as Slack and Teams. Important actions need your approval, but the launch also showed that the technology can still fail.
whyItMatters: Persistent agents could reduce routine coordination and document work, but they also widen the consequences of a mistaken action. Teams should treat permissions, audit trails and human approval points as core deployment requirements rather than optional safeguards.
friendlyWhyItMatters: These agents may save time on everyday work. They also need clear limits and checks because one mistake can spread across several apps.
